package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for save_for_single_column_change: GORM Save used for a single-column update instead of a targeted Update call.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
type Rule294PositiveRecord struct {
	ID     int
	Name   string
	Email  string
	Status string
}

func scenario294Positive(db *gorm.DB, userID int) error {
	var user Rule294PositiveRecord
	if err := db.First(&user, userID).Error; err != nil {
		return err
	}
	user.Status = "active"
	return db.Save(&user).Error
}
